Question: What is a product group?

Options: 
A. A group of firms producing similar, but not identical, products
B. A group of identical products
C. A classification of products based on their manufacturing process rather than their function
D. A collection of products with different functions that are sold together as a bundle
E. A set of services offered by a single company
F. A group of complementary products that are often used together
G. A group of firms producing identical products
H. A group of products designed for a specific demographic group
I. A group of products from different industries categorized under a single label
J. A group of unrelated products

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
